fieldValues.title: A shared paragraph has a home essay; editing it elsewhere is a deliberate choice
fieldValues.move: When an essay is copied, each shared paragraph keeps the essay it came from as its home, recorded once as a relation in the essay package; the writer can move the home by hand. The Also-in badge lists the other essays that hold the paragraph and jumps to it in each. Editing a shared paragraph anywhere but its home asks first: change it in every essay, or make a local copy (the existing make-local-copy action).
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Which version of a diverged copy is right, and merging copies back together. Paragraphs shared between repositories.
fieldValues.falsifier: The writer changes a paragraph in one essay and later finds another essay changed without having chosen it, or cannot tell from a paragraph which essays hold it and which is its home.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: shared paragraphs need a master; see the state and jump between them
fieldValues.return_when: After the owner has worked across several essays that share paragraphs for two weeks, or when a second writer shares paragraphs with the owner.
